newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Cityland says Q4 net at 79.47 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Cityland says Q4 net at 79.47 mln pesos.

text.p: Cityland Development Corp posted a net income of 79.47 million pesos in the fourth quarter last year, documents submitted to the Philippines' Securities and Exchange Commission on Monday said.
Gross profits from sale and rental fees of its residential and office condominiums reached 192.34 million pesos in the period while operating expenses amounted to 57.28 million pesos, it said.
Interest and other expenses totalled 36.65 million pesos, leading to before-tax profit of 98.41 million pesos, it said.
The company did not give comparative figures.
